title: Evil Dead Burn
plot_overview: After her husband dies suddenly, a grieving widow turns to his family for support, only to face growing danger as they are overtaken by demonic forces. Trapped in an isolated family home, she must confront a terrifying ordeal shaped by fear, grief, and the bonds that endure.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you like relentless, intensely gory horror with bursts of dark humor and an isolated-family setting; Not for you if graphic violence or cruelty is difficult to watch.
review_summary: Pros: relentless horror; gruesome set pieces; dark humor | Cons: extreme violence; uneven pacing; familiar story
